name: Existing Case with null checksum does not prevent new Case creation
description: Verifies that when a Case exists without a checksum value (created via SF CLI, bypassing email handler) and an email with identical subject and body is received, a new Case is still created because the null checksum does not match.

emailProperties.htmlBody: This is the body for the checksum null handling test. It will be identical to the precondition Case content.
